tools.name: birth_chart
tools.description: Computes a natal (birth) chart from the date, local clock time and place of birth: the Sun, Moon, planets, lunar node and Lilith in the signs of the tropical zodiac and in the houses, the ascendant and midheaven, house cusps (Placidus or whole sign), aspects with orbs, the phase of the Moon, the Chi

tools.name: sky_at
tools.description: Where the Sun, Moon and planets are in the zodiac at a moment (now when no date is given): signs and degrees, which planets are retrograde, aspects between them, the Moon's sign, phase and next sign change, the next new and full moon. With a place it adds the ascendant, midheaven and houses. For que

tools.name: sign_dates
tools.description: When the Sun enters each zodiac sign in a given year (1900–2100), to the minute, in a time zone (Polish time by default). With a sign, also its usual first and last day and the earliest and latest entry across 1900–2100. For "what is my sign" when someone is born near the edge of two signs.

tools.name: chinese_year
tools.description: The Chinese zodiac of a year (1901–2100): animal, element, yin or yang, the sexagenary name, the dates of Chinese New Year and of the year's last day, and Lichun. With a date of birth instead, which Chinese year and sign it falls in (January and February births often belong to the year before) and t

tools.name: astro_calendar
tools.description: The events of a month (2020–2035): new and full moons and quarters with their signs, the Sun and planets entering signs, retrograde stations and all retrograde periods touching the month, solar and lunar eclipses with their visibility from Warsaw; optionally every Moon sign change. Times in a time z

tools.name: synastry
tools.description: Compares two birth charts: the aspects between the planets (and ascendant and midheaven when known) of the two people, the most exact first, and each person's planets in the other's houses. Each person is an object with date, time (optional), place (or lat, lon, tz) and name (optional). Calculations

tools.name: transits
tools.description: The planets of a day (today by default) against a birth chart: their houses in it, their aspects to the points of birth, and the exact transits of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto to it for twelve months. Calculations only, no forecast.

tools.name: vedic_chart
tools.description: A birth chart in the sidereal zodiac (Lahiri ayanamsa): the lagna, the nine grahas in their rashis with nakshatras and padas, whole-sign houses, navamsa (D9) signs and the Vimshottari periods with the current mahadasha and antardasha. Without the hour no lagna or houses. Calculations only.

tools.name: solar_return
tools.description: The moment the Sun comes back to its place of birth in a year (this year by default), to the minute, and the chart of that moment for the place of the birthday (the place of birth by default): planets, ascendant and houses, and the returns of the next years.

tools.name: planet_returns
tools.description: When Saturn (about at 29, 59 and 88) and Jupiter (about every 12 years) come back to their places of birth: each return with its dates and the age, three crossings when retrograde motion takes the planet back over the place.

tools.name: sky_card
tools.description: Makes a printable card of the sky on a day that matters - a birthday, the birth of a child, a wedding or any day - at a place: the link opens the sky map over that place (at the given hour, or 22:00) with a title, a line, the Moon's phase, sunrise and sunset, the planets, the signs and a QR code of

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Coordinates and IANA time zone of a town or city: all places in Poland and world cities over 15 000 people, Polish names first (Londyn and London both work). Use it to check which place birth_chart or sky_at would take, or to pick one of several of the same name and pass its lat, lon and tz.
